# Sign-up flow

New users sign up from the homepage by clicking "Sign up" in the top-right nav. The sign-up
form requires an email address and a password of at least 8 characters. On success, the user is
redirected to `/welcome` and shown a confirmation banner reading "Account created".

# Password reset

Users can reset a forgotten password from the login page via the "Forgot password?" link. A
reset email is sent, and the link in that email expires after 1 hour.
